ui.name: query
ui.label: Query
ui.help: A [LogsQL](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/) query, e.g. `error` or `service.name:=my-service level:in(error, warn)`. The tile's timeframe is applied automatically. Two shortcuts are available: `| normalize_severity` adds a `severity` field (critical, error, warning, info, debug or unknown) from the log's severity fields, OpenTelemetry severity number or message, and `| normalize_k8s` adds `cluster`, `namespace`, `pod` and `container` fields from whichever Kubernetes field convention the log uses.

ui.name: scope
ui.label: Objects (optional)
ui.help: Only include logs from the selected objects. Leave empty to search all logs.

ui.name: limit
ui.label: Limit
ui.help: Maximum number of log entries to return, newest first (up to 500).

max.message: At most 500 log entries can be returned

ui.name: columns
ui.label: Columns (optional)
ui.help: Comma-separated log fields to show as their own columns. All other fields are available in the **Fields** column.
